module_summary: ARP frame receiver: latches the Ethernet header, then a two-state header FSM with a word pointer extracts ARP fields byte-by-byte from the AXI-Stream payload and emits them in parallel with valid/ready plus error flags.

anchors.name: read_arp_header_reg
anchors.why: Header-parse state: enables ARP field capture from payload words

anchors.name: read_eth_header_reg
anchors.why: Waiting-for-Ethernet-header state of the two-state parser

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: Payload word counter selecting which ARP header field is captured

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Ethernet header valid starting frame parse

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready while idle and output not pending

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Payload bytes carrying ARP header fields

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload beat valid advancing header parse

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready asserted while consuming frame

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of frame triggering validation and output

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte-valid mask qualifying header byte capture

anchors.name: m_frame_valid
anchors.why: Decoded ARP frame valid after complete, valid header

anchors.name: m_frame_ready
anchors.why: Downstream accept clearing frame valid

anchors.name: m_arp_oper
anchors.why: Decoded ARP operation field output

anchors.name: m_arp_sha
anchors.why: Decoded sender hardware address

anchors.name: m_arp_spa
anchors.why: Decoded sender protocol address

anchors.name: m_arp_tpa
anchors.why: Decoded target protocol address

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Latched Ethernet destination MAC

anchors.name: store_eth_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching Ethernet header fields

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy while ARP header is being read

anchors.why: Pulse when frame ends before full ARP header

anchors.name: error_invalid_header
anchors.why: Pulse when HLEN/PLEN are invalid
